records.text: We shall play every game to the hilt with every ounce of fiber we have in our bodies.
records.speaker: Vince Lombardi

records.text: Gentlemen, we are going to relentlessly chase perfection, knowing full well we will not catch it, because nothing is perfect. But we are going to relentlessly chase it, because in the process we will catch excellence. I am not remotely interested in just being good.
records.speaker: Vince Lombardi
